t2.thesis: QSR is a steady mid-single-digit beater whose open-to-open earnings reactions have been small and two-sided, and recent upbeat previews plus a ~5% one-month run-up raise the bar enough to trim the consumer base rate slightly.
reasons: Last 4 prints all beat EPS by 1-4%, yet open-to-open reactions were split 2-2 and small (-2.6% to +2.2%), so beats are largely expected.
Pre-print sentiment is upbeat: RBC flags comp upside, Zacks-style ESP is positive, estimates were nudged up, and the stock is up ~3.7% over 1m. That raises expectations.
Option positioning is mildly defensive: put skew ~5.6 pts and put/call OI 1.66. The event move implied by term structure is ~4.5%, versus an ATM IV/RV60 of 1.29.
Risk flags in the previews: record beef costs and one struggling brand (likely Popeyes U.S. or Tim Hortons traffic), with McDonald's and peer U.S. traffic softness as a backdrop.
The stock sits 8% below its 52w high with a forward P/E of ~16.7, so the valuation is not stretched and a clean comp beat could still get rewarded.
t2.deciding_variable: Burger King U.S. and Tim Hortons Canada comparable sales versus consensus, plus any commentary on beef-cost pressure on franchisee margins and U.S. traffic.

prior.from: I3 by_cluster consumer t0_hit 0.555 (n=436), consistent with BMO session 0.548 and overall ~0.54

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. That earnings report (October 29, 2026) is two days after today's date, so it hasn't happened yet, and it's also beyond my knowledge cutoff of June 2026.
t2.moved_from_prior: Down about 2 pts, from 0.55 to 0.53. Bullish previews and the recent run-up raise the bar for a stock whose beats get muted reactions. Mildly defensive skew and peer U.S. traffic weakness offset positive estimate revisions and reasonable valuation.

theses.mechanism: BK U.S. comps and INTL system-wide growth beat, consolidated comps hold near ~4%, EPS beats by ~3%, and the 2028 algorithm is reaffirmed.
theses.wrong_if: The comp beat is driven by price or promotion with negative traffic, or Popeyes U.S. comps remain negative and worsen.

theses.mechanism: Elevated expectations after positive previews meet softer TH or Popeyes comps and beef-driven franchisee profitability concerns, so a small EPS beat fails to lift the stock.
theses.wrong_if: Comps clearly beat across TH, BK and INTL and management raises segment outlooks.

theses.mechanism: An in-line quarter with a small EPS beat largely priced in, consistent with the muted history of reactions.
theses.wrong_if: There is a material surprise in comps (>1pt vs consensus) or in capital-return or refranchising news.
